description:
- Organized settings into 15 patches and six categories.
- Added Material You colors with charcoal fallback.
- Added rounded Light/Dark icons and matching static splash.
- Refined onboarding and Rewards styling.
- Fixed OTP paste across digit boxes.
- Added optional personal-details skip after OTP.
- Fixed neutral Usage values and navigation feedback.
- Reduced bundle blinking and Home button flashes.
- Made the loading rings loop smoothly.

patches.name: Bottom navigation
patches.description: Configure the bottom bar, tab labels and individual tabs.

options.description: Display the whole bottom navigation bar. Turning off hides every tab while retaining the individual tab choices below.
Display labels beneath the bottom navigation icons. Turning off keeps icons only; it does not hide any tab.
Display More in the bottom navigation bar. The whole-bar setting takes precedence.
Display Z Play in the bottom navigation bar. Turning off hides that tab without deleting its destination.
Display Usage in the bottom navigation bar. Consider how you will return to Usage before hiding it.
Display Bundles in the bottom bar. When hidden, Header can provide a replacement shortcut on Home.

patches.name: Bundles and Usage
patches.description: Configure the Bundles controls button and promotional sections.

options.description: Add a button beside Bundles search that hides/restores categories, validity chips and Filter by together. Its choice is remembered in the app.
Display advertising banners around supported bundle browsing/details areas. Offer cards remain available when off.
Display the large promotional banner above the Usage summary. Does not affect allowance cards.
Display the external-promotion label and advertising container on Usage. Subscription details remain available when off.

patches.name: Dialogs and drawer
patches.description: Configure the chatbot, WhatsApp notice and grouped drawer links.

options.description: Display the floating chatbot launcher and allow its dialog to open. Turning off hides the overlay and blocks its opening method.
Allow the Zong 5G WhatsApp 'AISA HAI FUTURE' / 'Follow!' notice, including notices triggered after refresh.
Display Press Release, Find Us, Contact Us, Video Tutorials, FAQs and Feedback as one group. The menu button is controlled under Header.

patches.name: Header
patches.description: Choose visible header items, titles and replacement shortcuts.

options.description: Display the notification bell in the top header. Turning off hides its launcher, not account notifications.
Display the top-header side-menu button. Drawer link visibility is configured under Dialogs and drawer.
Display the top-header refresh button. Turning off does not disable pull-to-refresh.
Display header search outside Bundles. Bundles keeps its search button even when this option is off.
Display the Home greeting. When off, the optional Home title can occupy that space.
Align supported top-header titles to the start edge instead of centering them. Button positions are retained.
Display 'Home' in the Home header only when the greeting is hidden. Does not replace a greeting you kept.
Add a Home header shortcut to Bundles when its bottom tab or the whole bottom bar is hidden.
Add a gift icon to the Home header that opens daily rewards, even when the Home shortcuts tray is hidden.
Add a Home header shortcut using the existing take/pay loan action. It remains available when the Home loan button is hidden.

patches.name: Home account cards
patches.description: Configure allowance labels, SMS, tariff, recharge and loan controls.

options.description: Display the 'X offers active' labels below Home data/minutes/SMS. Turning off keeps the values and progress bars.
Display SMS beside Home data and minutes. When hidden, the two remaining cards expand. Usage SMS is unaffected.
Display the tariff/package line, such as Economy Package, under the Home balance-expiry date.
Display the recharge button in the Home balance header. Recharge tabs are configured separately under Recharge.
Display the take/pay loan button on the Home account card. The optional Header loan shortcut works separately.

patches.name: Home sections
patches.description: Choose which Home sections remain visible and adjust section spacing.

options.description: Display the sports/match information card on Home. Turn off to remove the whole card.
Display prayer/Ramadan timings on Home. Turn off to remove that timing card.
Display the complete family-sharing button group and MY5 banner on Home.
Display the start-your-streak and seven-day streak panels on Home.
Display Home banners, flash sales, hot offers and the entertainment row beneath the banners.
Display the Home 5G map, settings and bundle shortcut group. Other bundle access is unaffected.
Display the Z Wallet section on Home. This does not change your wallet or account.
Display the Home step shortcut and step-counter panel together.
Display the Home location/weather strip and its expand arrow together.
Display the regional/city offer search section on Home, independently of other promotions.
Keep at least 24dp above the utility-shortcuts tray and regional/city offers so adjacent sections do not touch.

patches.name: Home shortcuts
patches.description: Keep only the selected home options. Defaults to Rewards and Rs 100 Shop; no other items are kept automatically.

options.description: Display the Home utility-shortcuts tray and its kept entries. Turning off overrides the keep list, but not the three large bundle shortcuts.
Display Make Your Own Bundle in the three-button Home row. The other two shortcuts remain independently configurable.
Display Bachat Bazaar in the three-button Home row. If every button is hidden, the row collapses.
Display Zong4U in the three-button Home row. Remaining buttons reflow when others are hidden.

Choose multiple names in this list. Unlisted or future shortcuts stay hidden. Use the displayed shortcut names, including any names added by the server. Examples: Rewards, Free MBs, Daraz Hot Deals, Brief History, Rs 100 Shop, 20% Off, IR, Tax Certificate, Balance Save, Yaari Load, Call Blocks, Book Your Number, Value Added Services, Business Sales Leads. An empty list hides all shortcuts.

patches.name: Launcher icon
patches.description: Use a rounded Light or Dark ring for the launcher and static startup logo. Leave unselected to keep the original icon.

options.description: Light: off-white background and charcoal ring. Dark: charcoal background and off-white ring.

patches.name: Material allowance icons
patches.description: Use Material accent colors on Home and Usage allowance icons.

patches.name: Material shapes
patches.description: Rounded Home and Usage cards, pill primary buttons and softer dialogs.

patches.name: Material usage favorite star
patches.description: Use the Material accent for selected Usage and Bundles stars.

patches.name: Material You theme
patches.description: Dark Material You colors on Android 12+, with automatic charcoal fallback on older or unsupported devices.

options.description: Use Android 12+ system colors for surfaces, text, tracks and accents. Turn off to use charcoal. Missing system colors fall back automatically.

patches.name: Recharge
patches.description: Choose recharge sections and promotional content.

options.description: Display Online Recharge and its tab in the recharge pager. The Home recharge button is configured separately.
Display Scratch Card and its tab in the recharge pager. Does not change other recharge methods.
Display banners and inline promotions within Online Recharge. Has no visible effect when that section is hidden.

patches.name: Skip daily reward ad
patches.description: Use My Zong's existing direct-claim branch when tapping the daily reward bubble.

patches.name: Startup
patches.description: Configure the intro, initial Home cover and starting screen.

options.description: After successful OTP sign-in, continue to Home instead of asking for optional personal details. Profile opened from navigation and wallet identity-verification forms remain available. No personal fields are submitted.

Distribute pasted or keyboard-committed multi-digit codes across the current PIN/OTP row. Full codes replace the row; shorter pastes start at the focused box and clear its remaining digits. Normal typing and native validation stay active.
Replace the animated startup intro with the existing centered static logo. Sign-in and startup/session checks still run.
Keep the centered logo cover until Home loading and three clean frames settle, for roughly 450ms–1.8s. Reduces flashes of hidden sections.
Open Usage on a fresh launch after sign-in. Restored screens and deep links are respected; Home stays in navigation history.
